## Summary
A passionate individual who thrives on building end-to-end products that develop sustainable and scalable social and technical systems to create impact. I specialize in Next.js frontend architecture, backend API design with PostgreSQL/Supabase, and integrating AI/LLMs into practical, scalable applications.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend Architecture**: Building responsive, highly scalable, and pixel-perfect web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
- **Backend & Databases**: Designing robust server architectures and secure RESTful APIs using Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Supabase.
- **AI & Data Science**: Integrating LLMs into real-world applications, building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Vector DBs, Scikit-Learn, and FastAPI.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Implementing CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications with Docker, and deploying on AWS, Vercel, Netlify, and Railway.
- **Business Automations**: Connecting disparate systems using n8n, Webhooks, and API integrations to build automated workflows.

3. **FlashFetch**

4. **NBA 2026 Playoff Predictor**
